about_short_description.short_description: Enabling the transition to a zero-carbon future.

product.name: Landfill Methane Emissions System
product.description: A system that captures landfill gas and converts it into high-grade graphene and hydrogen, reducing methane emissions and producing valuable commodities.

product.name: Construction Emissions Technologies
product.description: Technologies that enhance construction materials, such as graphene-enhanced products, to reduce carbon emissions and improve efficiency in the construction industry.

product.name: Legacy Real Estate Emissions Solutions
product.description: Technological solutions aimed at reducing the carbon footprint and energy costs of existing buildings, particularly through improved air conditioning and heating systems.

product.name: LOOP Technology
product.description: A device that processes captured methane to produce hydrogen and graphene, reducing the climate impact of methane emissions from various industries.

product.name: Zero Carbon Green Planet (ZCGP)
product.description: A joint venture focused on converting waste methane and organic waste into valuable products like graphene, hydrogen, and fertilizers, aiming to build a circular economy.
